examples.arabic: انا كنت فاكر انه مصري عشان بيتكلم عربي كويس
examples.english: I thought he was Egyptian because he speaks Arabic well.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont faker inno masry ashan beyetkallem araby kwayyes.

examples.arabic: المدرس بيقول يلا بينا نذاكر عربي
examples.transliteration: El modarres bi'oul yalla bina nezaker arabi.

examples.arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله عندنا حصة عربي دلوقتي
examples.english: I'm good, praise be to God. We have an Arabic class now.
examples.transliteration: Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah, andena hessa Arabi delwa'ti.

examples.arabic: هي كانت بتحاول تتكلم عربي والنطق بتاعها كان لسه ناقصه شوية تدريب
examples.english: She was trying to speak Arabic, and her pronunciation was still missing a bit of practice
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet be-t7awel tetkallem 3araby wel-not2 beta3ha kan lessa na2so shwayet tadrib

examples.arabic: كان عندنا امتحان عربي وصعب شوية
examples.english: We had an Arabic exam and it was a bit difficult
